title: crambe hispanica var. glabrata
intro: Crambe hispanica var. glabrata, commonly known as Spanish sea kale, is a type of plant in the Brassicaceae family that is native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used for its potential health benefits, including supporting cardiovascular health and reducing inflammation, due to its rich content of omega-3 fatty acids and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Crambe hispanica var. glabrata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-hyperlipidemic properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include omega-3 fatty acids, particularly alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), as well as various antioxidants, such as polyphenols and flavonoids.
